name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is an emerging gold royalty and exploration company focused exclusively on the state of Nevada. The company's business model combines mineral royalty acquisition, precious-metals streaming, and an exploration project accelerator, with its flagship asset being a 3% Net Smelter Royalty and an Exploration Stream Earn-in Agreement on the Lapon Canyon gold project within Nevada's high-grade Walker Lane trend. An active 2026 reverse-circulation drill program is advancing the project toward its first NI 43-101 compliant resource estimate.
